commands.review_summary:
The PR threads a `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` flag through embedded run results and uses it to bypass `message_tool_only` fallback suppression for terminal failure delivery.

PR surface: Source +27, Tests +129. Total +156 across 8 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main records `non_deliverable_terminal_turn`, and the message-tool-only outbound path is suppressed without a propagated terminal marker. I did not establish a live Octo or other SDK-channel reproduction.

target.title: fix(core): surface non_deliverable_terminal_turn as outbound fallback to channel plugins
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #102113

When `resolveAttemptTrajectoryTerminal()` classifies a run as `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` (e.g. `stopReason=toolUse` with no committed delivery evidence, or no visible output produced), the `terminalError` field was written only to the trajectory recorder and never propagated to `EmbeddedAgentRunResult.meta`. As a result:

- `agent-runner-execution.ts` never set `terminalRunFailed=true` for this case
- `followup-runner.ts` built no fallback payload
- `message_tool_only` channels (e.g. openclaw-channel-octo) received nothing and went completely silent

## Root Cause

`attempt-trajectory-status.ts` sets `terminalError: NON_DELIVERABLE_TERMINAL_TURN_REASON` on the `AttemptTrajectoryTerminal` object, but the flag was never propagated through run metadata. Three distinct gaps:

1. `EmbeddedAgentRunMeta` had no `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` field
2. `agent-runner-execution.ts` did not check for it when setting `terminalRunFailed`
3. Both delivery gates in `followup-runner.ts` (line 1568 + line 1739) blocked fallback delivery unconditionally for `message_tool_only` channels

## Fix (6 files, +152/-3)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `types.ts` | Add `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn?: true` to `EmbeddedAgentRunMeta` |
| `run/types.ts` | Add `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn?: true` to `EmbeddedRunAttemptResult` |
| `attempt.ts` | Expose the flag in the attempt return value |
| `run.ts` | Pass it through to `meta` in the normal terminal return path |
| `agent-runner-execution.ts` | Read `meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` → set `terminalRunFailed=true` + supply fallback text |
| `followup-runner.ts` | Exempt `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` from both `message_tool_only` gates (line 1568 + line 1739) + include in local `terminalRunFailed` condition (line 1457) |

## Path Reachability

```
resolveAttemptTrajectoryTerminal()           // attempt-trajectory-status.ts:103
  └─ stopReason=toolUse + no delivery evidence
       → terminalError: NON_DELIVERABLE_TERMINAL_TURN_REASON

runEmbeddedAttempt() return                  // attempt.ts (new field)
  └─ nonDeliverableTerminalTurn: true

runEmbeddedAgentInternal() meta              // run.ts (new pass-through)
  └─ meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn: true

runAgentTurnWithFallbackInternal()           // agent-runner-execution.ts (new branch)
  └─ else if (...|| meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn)
       → terminalRunFailed = true
       → terminalErrorMessage = "The agent run failed before producing a reply."

createFollowupRunner()                       // followup-runner.ts (three gaps patched)
  gate 1 (line 1568): fallbackPayload built when nonDeliverableTerminalTurn=true
  gate 2 (line 1739): message_tool_only early-return skipped when nonDeliverableTerminalTurn=true
  gate 3 (line 1457): local terminalRunFailed now includes nonDeliverableTerminalTurn
  → buildTerminalAgentRunFailureReplyPayload(...)
  → sendRunPayloads → channel outbound
```

## Tests Added (5 focused tests, 2 files)

**`agent-runner-execution.test.ts`** (inside `runAgentTurnWithFallback` describe):
1. `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn=true` + `message_tool_only` → `terminalFailurePayload` present with correct text/isError
2. `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn=true` without `message_tool_only` → `terminalFailurePayload` present
3. Regression: normal successful turn in `message_tool_only` → `terminalFailurePayload` undefined

**`followup-runner.test.ts`**:
4. `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn=true` + `message_tool_only` → passes both gates, fallback reaches delivery
5. Normal `message_tool_only` turn → stays suppressed

## Behavior Proof

This PR runs against the private openclaw-channel-octo gateway. The `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` scenario occurs non-deterministically when `stopReason=toolUse` and delivery evidence is not committed. Source-level path reachability has been verified and confirmed by two rounds of codex review (r2d2). Live session output would expose private endpoint URLs, group IDs, and user data; the verified source chain above with matching tests is the available evidence.

## Maintainer Decision Required

**Question:** Should `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` bypass `message_tool_only` suppression as a narrow core fallback (this PR / Option A), or should OpenClaw expose a plugin-owned terminal-failure hook instead (Option B)?

cc @vincentkoc @steipete — The linked issue #102113 is labeled `needs-maintainer-review` + `needs-product-decision`. This PR implements Option A. If Option B is preferred, this branch can be reshaped without a new PR.

## Related

- Issue: #102113
- Channel-side tracking: Mininglamp-OSS/openclaw-channel-octo#150
